# Chokepoint stats reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_stats.py from config/*.yaml; don't edit by hand. -->

Generated from the game's config by [`scripts/gen_stats.py`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/scripts/gen_stats.py); don't edit it by hand.

Every tower, enemy and wave of Chokepoint, with the numbers the game uses.

- [Towers](towers.md): price, upgrade cost, range, blind spot, damage, fire rate and DPS per level.
- [Enemies](enemies.md): base stats and how HP and kill money grow wave by wave.
- [Waves](waves.md): what every wave sends, with its total HP, kill money and lives at stake.

## The basics

- A run starts with **$200** and **10 lives**.
- Clearing wave 25 wins the run; endless mode carries on after it. The HUD calls a wave a *round*.
- Waves 1 to 30 are authored in [`config/waves.yaml`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/config/waves.yaml); later ones are generated by the game.
- Selling a tower refunds 70% of everything spent on it (purchase plus upgrades), rounded down.

## Units

- Distances are in pixels (px); a tile is 64 px.
- The game runs 165 ticks per second at x1 speed. Movement speeds are in px per tick, and in px per second at x1. x2 and x4 speed everything up evenly.
- Times are in milliseconds (ms) or seconds (s) of game time.
- Money is in coins ($). Lives lost is how many lives an enemy costs when it escapes.

## Sources

The pages are generated from [`config/towers.yaml`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/config/towers.yaml), [`config/enemies.yaml`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/config/enemies.yaml), [`config/waves.yaml`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/config/waves.yaml) and [`config/settings.yaml`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/config/settings.yaml). CI fails when they no longer match, and the wiki copy is refreshed from them on every change merged to `main`.
